b1.text: Recovery: commit database changes before acknowledging a batch. Replay a failed batch using its durable identity.
Pagination: a cursor identifies the next page. Persist the cursor only after its rows commit successfully.
Evaluation: measure retrieval using labeled relevant documents. Report precision, recall and reciprocal rank.
Timezone: use aware timestamps. Convert an instant to UTC and retain the source timezone name.

b2.text: HTTP retries: respect Retry-After and use bounded backoff. Log the status code without exposing credentials.
Python validation: reject bool when an exact integer is required. Strings and integers have different boundaries.
